name: zzp_trips_tax_log_redesign
description: Redesign zzp_trips into a pure Belastingdienst kilometer log: add free-text client_name (Klant); remove the never-approved trip-billing model by dropping the contact_id and invoice_id foreign keys, the billing indexes (idx_admin_contact, idx_admin_billed, idx_zzp_trips_unbilled), and the billing columns (contact_id, invoice_id, is_billable, is_billed).
